content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The model is the highest claim stage 2 makes: what a draft is, how many an edit or a node may carry, and that landing stays a recording into one node. The gate forces every clause — the mapping, the cardinality, the own-workspace rule, the per-draft landing — to answer to attribution (D6), placement (D13) and invocation shape (D10), and to nothing else.
